discoveries: Jetstreamer supports bounded historical slot ranges from Old Faithful CAR archives; its README says Anza no longer maintains it and points to Vaultic as the continuation.

Yellowstone Faithful v0.7.30 exposes getBlock/getTransaction RPC over remote CAR and indexes but labels the archive tooling RFC/not production-ready. Epoch 1056 uses a 662,973,441,613-byte CAR and a 5,184,000-byte 12-byte-per-slot range index; getBlocks returned null in the tested release while getBlock worked. The current Jetstreamer README also says Old Faithful lacks account updates and describes its transactions as already-executed ledger data, not transaction execution.

For slot 456558897, Old Faithful and Solana Vibe Station independently agreed on block hash, previous hash, parent slot and all 457 ordered signatures; verified SYLPH staging decoded 9 Pump invocations into 10 events without touching the production database or feed latch.

discoveries: Repository describes a lightweight Geyser gRPC service for account and slot updates.

Plugin callback queues use bounded channels and try_send. A connected stream therefore does not prove complete event delivery.

Pinned current official Blockworks connector README, source, Cargo manifest and Yellowstone dependency tag at commit 42971e7d0a5c885f36723a4da54d307713b66c3a
discoveries: The Rust connector multiplexes multiple Yellowstone gRPC streams using a fastest-wins merge and includes automatic reconnect logic; it is a consumer library, unlike the validator-side Jito and QUIC plugins.

Its README explicitly states there is no guarantee messages are continuous, requires slot-bearing ordered messages for its merge logic, and warns processed commitment forms forks rather than one sequence.

The inspected fastest-wins implementation emits only an extracted slot greater than its running tip. A late lower/equal slot from another source is discarded, so it is unsuitable as canonical gap-free ingress without independent continuity checks.
